about.title: ABOUT SAMKO ARYA BHAVAN
narrative: Welcome to Arya Bhavan, London’s favourite Indian vegetarian restaurant, proudly serving authentic Indian vegetarian cuisine across Central London, Wembley, Tooting. As a South Indian restaurant vegetarian lovers adore, we offer everything from traditional South Indian vegetarian dishes, South and North Indian thali’s, crispy dosa near me, and South Indian breakfast near me options.

Our menu is 100% vegetarian, with dedicated vegan restaurant choices and Jain and vegan food restaurant selections for those who prefer specialised diets. Families choose us as their go-to family-friendly Indian vegetarian restaurant, while food lovers rate us among the top-rated Indian veg restaurants near me and the best dosa restaurant in London.

Inspired by authentic Indian flavours and expanding our legacy with branches in France, Belgium, Singapore, and the United Kingdom, Arya Bhavan continues to be a trusted South Indian vegetarian restaurant for diners everywhere.

faqs.q: Do you bring all the cooking equipment for live dosa catering?
faqs.a: We bring all the required equipment including cooker, gas, and other essentials.

faqs.q: Do you provide plates, spoons, and napkins?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide biodegradable disposable plates, spoons, forks, and napkins unless you specify otherwise.

faqs.q: How are the charges calculated for dosa catering?
faqs.a: We will go ahead with the plate count, not the head count. Please note only plate for one person.

faqs.q: Is there a transportation fee for catering services?
faqs.a: Yes, transportation is charged at £2 per mile to and from the destination.

faqs.q: How long do you serve food at an event?
faqs.a: We serve food for 2 hours at your premises, with an additional 30 minutes required for setup. Extra time beyond this will be charged at £60 per hour.

faqs.q: What do customers need to provide for the setup?
faqs.a: Not required we will bring our own tables.

faqs.q: What is the payment policy for booking live dosa catering?
faqs.a: 30% token of advance to confirm the event, balance can be paid end of the day.

faqs.q: Can I customize the menu with additional items?
faqs.a: Yes, you can add with extra cost.

faqs.q: Do you provide tents or gazebos for outdoor catering?
faqs.a: No, we do not provide tents or gazebos.

faqs.q: Do your dishes contain allergens such as nuts or sesame?
faqs.a: At Arya Bhavan Restaurant, our food is prepared in a kitchen where nuts, sesame, and other allergenic ingredients are used, and despite our care, we cannot guarantee that any dish is completely free from allergen traces. Therefore, our menu may not be suitable for individuals with severe food allergies.

reviews.name: Priya Sharma
reviews.comment: The Masala Dosa and Filter Coffee at Leicester Square is unmatched in London! The sambar has that authentic home-style flavor that reminds me of Chennai. Outstanding service!

reviews.name: Rohan Patel
reviews.comment: Best pure vegetarian restaurant in Wembley. We booked their Live Dosa Catering for our daughter’s birthday party last month and guests are still talking about how delicious and crispy the dosas were.

reviews.name: Sarah Jenkins
reviews.comment: Such a warm, welcoming restaurant. As a vegan, finding food that is 100% pure and clearly marked is fantastic. The Gobi 65 and Paneer Tikka Masala were heavenly!
